# REST API Versioning Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > REST API

## Overview

Implements API versioning strategies including URL, header, and query parameter versioning with proper deprecation management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rest-api-versioning-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rest-api-versioning-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rest-api-versioning-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement URL path-based versioning
- Configure header-based versioning
- Design query parameter versioning
- Manage version deprecation lifecycle

## Technology Standards Applied

- **API Versioning**: Versioning strategy comparison and selection
- **Deprecation**: API deprecation and sunset policies
- **Backward Compatibility**: Non-breaking change guidelines
